asset.name: qCmdUtl - Streamlined building
asset.description:
A plugin designed to streamline building and creation in Roblox Studio. 

5.1.5
- Fix plugin saving

5.1.4
 - Prevent FormFactor spam

5.1.3 Changelog
 - Remove output spam from keys
 - Fixed FormFactor to reflect ROBLOX's new policy (resize tool)
 - Cleaned up legacy code
 - Started change log
 - Duplicate [NM] should no longer crash when cloning folders

Anaminus's 5.00 CmdUtl modified to include shortcuts, UNDO, Scaling, among other commands.

It's not perfect, you may want to change your settings in studio to allow for more comprehensive undo that doesn't glitch. However, it's the best there is. 

The most commonly used shortcuts:
Shift + C --> Duplicate No-Move (Duplicates a part without moving it)
              This is so useful. I can't live without it. 

V --> Select Edge
      Second most useful tool ever.

Z --> Rotate (Model)
      Obvious application is obvious

## ### Move (First)
      Still obvious.

## ### Resize
      Why do you need descriptions?

asset.name: Bloxburg Building Tools V1
asset.description:
Bloxburg Building Tool V2: 
https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/82011264724937

🏠 Bloxburg Building Tools Classic is the original legacy version of BLOXBURG Building Tools V2.

🔐 Includes 1-on-1 support for setup, troubleshooting, and questions.

Classic is a lower-cost option for creators who only want the older basic Bloxburg-style placement workflow. It is still usable, but it is not the main recommended version and does not include the major improvements from V2.

For the full modern experience, get **BLOXBURG Building Tools V2**. V2 is the complete rebuild with smarter wall logic, cleaner openings, doors, windows, trims, automatic floors, automatic roofs, multi-floor building, multi-plot support, multi-map management, cloning, grouping, recoloring, styling, and a much more powerful building workflow.

Choose **Classic** only if you want the cheaper legacy version.
Choose **V2** if you want the full building engine.
